id: \bI can turn fossils into living, breathing Pokémon!
en: \bI can turn fossils into living, breathing Pokémon!
it: \bPosso trasformare i fossili in Pokémon vivi e vegeti!

id: <c2=6546675A>Do you have a fossil for me to revive?
en: <c2=6546675A>Do you have a fossil for me to revive?

id: \bLet me know when you want me to revive a fossil for you.
en: \bLet me know when you want me to revive a fossil for you.
it: \bFammi sapere quando vuoi che ti rigeneri un fossile.

id: \bOkay. I'll see if I can revive your \v[3].
en: \bOkay. I'll see if I can revive your \v[3].
it: \bD'accordo. Vedrò se riesco a rigenerare il tuo \v[3].

id: \bWhere have you been? I've finished reviving your fossil.
en: \bWhere have you been?  I've finished reviving your fossil.
it: \bDove ti eri cacciato?  Ho finito di rigenerare il tuo fossile.

id: \bYou have no room left. Make room, then come see me.
en: \bYou have no room left.  Make room, then come see me.
it: \bNon hai più spazio.  Fai spazio, poi torna da me.
\bSono riuscito a rigenerare il tuo fossile.

id: \bHowever, what I brought back didn't live long...\1 fortunately.
en: \bHowever, what I brought back didn't live long...\1 fortunately.
it: \bPerò, quello che ho riportato in vita non è vissuto a lungo...\1 per fortuna.
